results.address: Wo Hop, 17 Mott St, New York, NY 10013

excerpts.text: Can honestly say its the best chinese food I have ever eaten! We have the chicken fried rice, pork fried Dumplings and General Tso Chicken. Nice staff and great table service. Would highly recomend.

Authentic Chinese food without breaking the bank. Try the shrimp ding. Mad good sauce. Mad fresh ingredients. Always had a full cup of water and a full glass of tea. Friendly staff, good eats, what else can you ask for? Nothing - that's what.

This place is amazing! This is the typical Cantonese style Chinese food! If you looking for traditional chinese food, not the americanized food this is the place! One of the best things you can order is the Shrimp with the Lobster sauce, it's just WOW! Wo hop never dissapoints!

results.name: Joe's Shanghai
results.address: Joe's Shanghai, 46 Bowery, New York, NY 10013

excerpts.text: Reasonably priced delicious Chinese food with compromised service. The Xiao long bao (soup dumplings) is amazing here. Beside coming in large size, the soup is very tasteful. Thanks to the thin wrap, each piece doesn't feel too heavy. I love how the soy vinegar for Xiao long bao came with thinly sliced ginger. …

Order 3 items. Normally can't miss at most Chinese place. Two were chicken items and they were fine. The sesame beef however was terrible. So chewy you could not break off a bite. You needed a knife. First time I actually tasted flour in my food. You know it is there but normally you don't taste it
Excellent place to eat truly Chinese food you have to make a line to wait to enter but once inside it is worth it

excerpts.text: The best Chinese food I have ever had, and it is kosher! Halleluyah.

Very tasty vegetarian Chinese food with a large selection. Most dishes are vegan, if not it is declared on the menu (dairy, with egg). Meat eaters are used by e.g. Be impressed by the meatless "Lemon Chicken", it tastes just like baked chicken.

If there was 6 a star rating available or more, Buddha Bodai would receive it! Best Chinese food hands down outside of China itself, and Kosher Dim Sum. Mock meat and mock seafood taste just like the real thing #bestchinesefood #vegan #dimsum #kosher #llamaste

results.name: Joe's Shanghai
results.address: Joe's Shanghai, 24 W 56th St, New York, NY 10019

excerpts.text: Inauthentic Chinese food (but I still consider it tasty; well-suited for my sweet tooth). This place is a typical "American Chinese restaurant". Most of the meat dishes our group ordered were covered with a sweet and usually fatty sauce. The soup dumplings, brewed tea and table service were good though. Food overall was ok ($200+ for 5 people)
There are "chinese food" restaurants on nearly every block it seems, but this place serves some actual Chinese dishes.

Szechuan beef noodle soup is another filling dish from this reataurant where everybody seems to only vouch for it's steamed dumplings. The beef is just melting in your mouth. Entree taste is pretty standard for Chinese food. Tiny soup. Fast service buy way too pricey for Chinese food. $85 for 4 dishes plus tips.
